cases.name: missing-theme-default
cases.condition: The theme has no default for this element type: themeDefault is undefined or the empty string. The function returns undefined without considering kind or componentNames.
cases.outcome: It returns undefined without considering kind or componentNames.
cases.domain: undefined or empty string

cases.name: exact-component-kind
cases.condition: themeDefault is non-empty and kind exactly equals an entry in componentNames as a raw string. The function returns kind unchanged, without stripping or adding qualifiers.
cases.outcome: It returns kind unchanged when kind exactly matches an entry in componentNames.
cases.domain: any non-empty kind string that is an exact componentNames entry

cases.name: undefined-kind-falls-back
cases.condition: themeDefault is non-empty and kind is undefined. With no exact kind to select, the function returns themeDefault.
cases.outcome: It returns themeDefault when kind is undefined.

cases.name: empty-kind-falls-back
cases.condition: themeDefault is non-empty and kind is the empty string. The function returns themeDefault.
cases.outcome: It returns themeDefault when kind is the empty string.

cases.name: qualified-kind-does-not-match
cases.condition: themeDefault is non-empty and kind is a qualified string such as "default.store", while componentNames contains only the unqualified counterpart such as "store". Exact raw-string comparison fails, so the function returns themeDefault.
cases.outcome: It returns themeDefault because the qualified kind does not exactly match the unqualified component name.
cases.domain: a qualified kind and its unqualified componentNames counterpart

cases.name: other-unmatched-kind-falls-back
cases.condition: themeDefault is non-empty and kind is a non-empty string that is not exactly present in componentNames. The function returns themeDefault unchanged; no theme name is added to the result.
cases.outcome: It returns themeDefault unchanged when the non-empty kind is not exactly present in componentNames.
cases.domain: any non-empty kind string absent from componentNames

cases.name: undefined-current
cases.condition: current is undefined; the function returns true without comparing it to themeDefault.
cases.outcome: Return true immediately without comparing current to themeDefault.
cases.domain: any non-empty themeDefault string

cases.name: empty-current
cases.condition: current is the empty string; the function returns true without comparing it to themeDefault.
cases.outcome: Return true immediately without comparing current to themeDefault.
cases.domain: any non-empty themeDefault string

cases.name: matching-split-parts
cases.condition: current is non-empty, and splitting current and themeDefault produces the same theme name and the same component name; the function returns true. This includes an unqualified current equal to an unqualified themeDefault, and a qualified default-theme current equivalent to the unqualified default.
cases.outcome: Split both values and return true when their theme and component names are equal.
cases.domain: any non-empty current/themeDefault pair with identical split theme and component halves

cases.name: different-theme-name
cases.condition: current is non-empty, and its split theme name differs from themeDefault's split theme name, even if the component names match; the function returns false.
cases.outcome: Return false because the split theme names differ, even though the component names match.
cases.domain: any non-empty pair whose split theme names differ

cases.name: different-component-name
cases.condition: current is non-empty, and its split component name differs from themeDefault's split component name, even if the theme names match; the function returns false.
cases.outcome: Return false because the split component names differ, even though the theme names match.
cases.domain: any non-empty pair with equal split theme names and different split component names

cases.name: theme-absent
cases.condition: The theme argument is undefined; the function returns the stylesheet argument unchanged and does not seed any element.
cases.outcome: Returns the original stylesheet unchanged without seeding any element.

cases.name: graph-absent-with-annotations
cases.condition: The diagram has no graph but a theme is present; nodes, edges, and groups have no elements to enumerate, while existing stylesheet annotations are still considered for seeding.
cases.outcome: With a present theme, skips graph elements and still seeds existing stylesheet annotations.

cases.name: derived-component-absent
cases.condition: An element's kind does not derive a component name for its element type under the supplied theme; its component is not written, whether its stylesheet entry is absent, unset, empty, or already names a component.
cases.outcome: Leaves the element's component untouched regardless of whether its stylesheet entry is absent, unset, empty, or already named.
cases.domain: one of: node, edge, group, annotation

cases.name: derived-component-for-missing-entry
cases.condition: A graph element, or an existing stylesheet annotation, has a kind that derives a component name and has no stylesheet entry; a new entry is created with that bare derived component name.
cases.outcome: Creates the missing entry with the bare component name derived from the element's kind.
cases.domain: one of: node, edge, group, annotation

cases.name: derived-component-for-unset-entry
cases.condition: An element has an existing stylesheet entry whose component is undefined or empty, and its kind derives a component name; the entry is populated with the bare derived name.
cases.outcome: Populates the existing unset or empty component with the bare derived name.
cases.domain: one of: node, edge, group, annotation

cases.name: theme-default-current-component
cases.condition: An element's kind derives a component name and its existing component is recognized by isThemeDefault as the current theme's default, including an unset or empty component; the component is replaced with the bare derived name.
cases.outcome: Replaces a current-theme-default, unset, or empty component with the bare derived name, creating an entry when needed.
cases.domain: one of: node, edge, group, annotation

cases.name: explicit-current-component
cases.condition: An element's kind derives a component name but its existing component is not the current theme default; the existing component is left untouched, including when it names a component from another theme.
cases.outcome: Leaves a non-default existing component untouched, including one belonging to another theme.
cases.domain: one of: node, edge, group, annotation

cases.name: node-tags-from-graph
cases.condition: A node is enumerated from the diagram graph and its kind is read from the node's graph tags when deciding whether and which component to seed.
cases.outcome: Enumerates nodes from the graph and uses each node's graph tags to derive its component.
cases.domain: any graph node

cases.name: edge-tags-from-graph
cases.condition: An edge is enumerated from the diagram graph and its kind is read from the edge's graph tags when deciding whether and which component to seed.
cases.outcome: Enumerates edges from the graph and uses each edge's graph tags to derive its component.
cases.domain: any graph edge

cases.name: group-tags-from-graph
cases.condition: A group is enumerated from the diagram graph and its kind is read from the group's graph tags when deciding whether and which component to seed.
cases.outcome: Enumerates groups from the graph and uses each group's graph tags to derive its component.
cases.domain: any graph group

cases.name: annotation-tags-from-stylesheet
cases.condition: An annotation is enumerated from the stylesheet's annotations map and its kind is read from AnnotationEntry.tags; annotations are not required to exist in the diagram.
cases.outcome: Enumerates stylesheet annotations and uses each AnnotationEntry's tags, without requiring a diagram element.
cases.domain: any existing stylesheet annotation

cases.name: default-theme-bare-output
cases.condition: A component is seeded successfully; the returned entry contains exactly the bare name returned by deriveComponent, never a qualified name such as "default.name".
cases.outcome: Writes exactly the bare name returned by deriveComponent, never a qualified name.
cases.domain: one of: node, edge, group, annotation

cases.name: stylesheet-not-mutated
cases.condition: Seeding completes with any combination of writes or no-ops; the input stylesheet remains unchanged, and the returned stylesheet is a new stylesheet that carries the changes.
cases.outcome: Leaves the input stylesheet unchanged and returns a new stylesheet containing any seeding changes.
cases.domain: any valid stylesheet and theme combination

cases.name: idempotent-repeat
cases.condition: The returned stylesheet is passed through seeding again with the same diagram and theme; the second result is equal to the first, with no component names rewritten to different values.
cases.outcome: Produces the same stylesheet on a second seeding pass without rewriting component names.
cases.domain: any seedable diagram, stylesheet, and theme

cases.name: empty-graph-without-annotations
cases.condition: A present graph contains no nodes, edges, or groups and the stylesheet has no annotations; seeding has no element-level writes but still follows the normal new-result behavior when a theme is present.
cases.outcome: Performs no element-level writes and still returns the normal new stylesheet result for a present theme.
